items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: And Geneva, she died when I was about 16. She died at around 14. She was kind of chubby and fat and took pneumonia and died. Well, I went back to her funeral.

ctx.x: Can you remember the music when you were young? Did you play anything or other members of the family?

No members of my family played anything because the fact of it is I was away from my family then. I just considered myself having no family. I knew my sister was at home and I knew Peter was at home with my father in King Street, but the two smaller children, they were dead. And Geneva, she died when I was about 16. She died at around 14. She was kind of chubby and fat and took pneumonia and died. Well, I went back to her funeral. Mr. Jenkins sent me back. I was already a member of the band then also. See, in the…
And you played on those tours. Where did you play? Concerts or streets?
